author: Noema II
title: Snapshot OFF norms and build ON vs OFF comparison — test() only
abstract: Copies current z-norm JSONs as seed-suffixed OFF snapshots, then writes a per-dataset ON vs OFF comparison table (means, deltas, ratios) to storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms_on_off.md. Test-only; no training.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, glob

IN_DIR = "storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms"
OUT_MD = os.path.join(IN_DIR, "hdp_regcal_norms_on_off.md")

def _read(fp):
    with open(fp, "r") as f:
        j = json.load(f)
    return j

def _copy_off_snapshots():
    # Copy current unsuffixed JSONs (latest capture) to *_seed{seed}_off.json
    wrote = 0
    for fp in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(IN_DIR, "*.json"))):
        base = os.path.basename(fp)
        if "_seed" in base:
            continue  # already a snapshot (on/off)
        j = _read(fp)
        ds = j.get("dataset", base.replace(".json", ""))
        seed = j.get("seed", "NA")
        dst = os.path.join(IN_DIR, f"{ds}_seed{seed}_off.json")
        with open(dst, "w") as f:
            json.dump(j, f, indent=2)
        wrote += 1
    print(f"[Snapshot] Wrote {wrote} OFF snapshots.")
    return wrote

def _load_snapshots(suffix):
    snaps = {}
    for fp in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(IN_DIR, f"*_{suffix}.json"))):
        j = _read(fp)
        ds = j.get("dataset", os.path.basename(fp).split("_seed")[0])
        snaps[ds] = j
    return snaps

def test():
    os.makedirs(IN_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    # 1) Snapshot OFF from current unsuffixed JSONs
    _copy_off_snapshots()
    # 2) Load ON/OFF snapshots
    on = _load_snapshots("on.json")
    off = _load_snapshots("off.json")
    # 3) Build comparison table (use one snapshot per dataset if multiple present)
    header = "| Dataset | ON mean ||z||2 | OFF mean ||z||2 | Δ (OFF-ON) | Ratio (OFF/ON) | ON N | OFF N |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n"
    rows = []
    datasets = sorted(set(on.keys()) | set(off.keys()))
    for ds in datasets:
        on_s = on.get(ds, {}).get("summary", {})
        off_s = off.get(ds, {}).get("summary", {})
        on_mean = float(on_s.get("mean", 0.0))
        off_mean = float(off_s.get("mean", 0.0))
        d = off_mean - on_mean if (on_mean or off_mean) else 0.0
        r = (off_mean / on_mean) if on_mean not in (0, None) else 0.0
        on_n = int(on_s.get("n", 0))
        off_n = int(off_s.get("n", 0))
        rows.append(f"| {ds} | {on_mean:.4f} | {off_mean:.4f} | {d:.4f} | {r:.3f} | {on_n} | {off_n} |")
    body = "\n".join(rows) if rows else "_No snapshots found yet._"
    with open(OUT_MD, "w") as f:
        f.write("# HDP-RegCal — ON vs OFF pre-head fused feature norms (validation)\n\n")
        f.write(header + body + "\n\nNotes:\n- ON = RegCal enabled; OFF = RegCal disabled.\n- Means computed from captured summaries; ON snapshots: *_seed*_on.json; OFF snapshots: *_seed*_off.json.\n")
    print(f"Wrote {OUT_MD}")
    return "OK"
